extraction.text:
Abinash Patra

Business Analyst | Product Owner | Payments & Capital Markets Expert
 📞 +91 9703902455 | ✉️ abinash_p2005@yahoo.co.in

Professional Summary

Dynamic and certified Business Analyst and Product Owner with over 18 years of experience in Core Banking, Investment Banking, and Global Payments. Proven track record of leading regulatory transformations, digital payment innovations, and delivering high-impact projects using Agile/SAFe frameworks. Specialized in SWIFT (MT/MX), ISO 20022, FIX protocols, SEPA, and capital markets, with expertise in stakeholder management, product lifecycle ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Certifications

SAFe® 5 Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM)

SAFe® 5 Agilist (SA)

SAFe® 5 Scrum Master (SSM)

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

PRINCE2® Agile Practitioner

Certified International Payment Systems Professional (CIPSP™)

Equity Derivatives Certification – NISM (NSE India)

Fundamental Equity Analyst Certification – NISM (NSE India)

Chartered Wealth Manager (CWM) – Level 1

Key Skills & Expertise

End-to-End Business Analysis & Product Ownership

Agile, Scrum, SAFe Delivery Methodologies

Global Payments: SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, SEPA, CHAPS, FPS

Capital Markets: Trade Lifecycle, T+2, IPOs, FIX, Margin Trading

Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Visio, SQL, Charles River

Process Modelling, Workflow Analysis, UAT & QA Oversight

Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Stakeholder Communication

Capital Markets Experience

Delivered T+2 settlement projects for Tadawul Stock Exchange.

Led Aramco IPO implementation for NCBC (KSA).

Managed lifecycle integration using Charles River with investment banks.

Delivered Margin Trading (Islamic and conventional) systems at NCBC.

Created and onboarded regulatory profiles on Tadawul stock exchange applications.

Supported FIX messaging protocol testing and implementation.

Used SQL to extract, sort, and analyze user and transaction data.

Payments Domain Experience

Managed SWIFT MT messages: MT103, MT101, MT202, MT200, MT199, MT190, MT192, MT196.

Executed ISO 20022/CBPR+ transitions using Pacs.008, Pacs.009, CAMT messages.

Built and validated MX message files for inbound and outbound transactions.

Worked on SEPA STEP2, CHAPS, FPS, BULK, SO, and DD transactions.

Familiar with payment formats and codes – IBAN, BBAN, BIC.

Executed domestic/international payments with compliance to FATCA.

Core Responsibilities

Gathered business requirements and authored detailed documentation.

Acted as liaison between technical and business teams for smooth delivery.

Analyzed and optimized payment and trading workflows; created gap analyses.

Led UAT cycles, authored test plans, coordinated QA activities.

Created reports and dashboards for project status, risks, and progress.

Supported sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog prioritization.

Mentored teams on domain knowledge across payments and capital markets.

Professional Experience

Coforge, Hyderabad
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner
Aug 2021 – Present

Owned product requirements and backlog for global payment solutions.

Oversaw ISO 20022 implementation and CBPR+ compliance across channels.

Analyze the impact of migrating from legacy formats (e.g., MT103) to ISO 20022 messages (e.g., pacs.008, pacs.009)Facilitated UAT testing, defect triage, and business stakeholder reviews.

Perform detailed field-level mapping from legacy SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (e.g., MT103 to pacs.008).

Work with XML schemas (XSD), Message Implementation Guides (MIGs), and CBPR+ usage guidelines.

Define test cases for end-to-end payments flow involving ISO 20022 messages.

Collaborate with testing teams using tools like Iliad, SWIFT MyStandards, XML validators.

Verify message samples for pacs.002 (acknowledgement), camt.056 (returns), camt.029 (investigations) as below –

Customer Credit Transfer: pain.001 → pacs.008 → pacs.002 → camt.054

            Bank-to-Bank Transfer: pacs.009 → pacs.002 → camt.056

                                                    Direct Debit: pain.008 → pacs.003 → pacs.002

                                      Reconciliation: camt.052/053/054

ITC Infotech, Bangalore
Senior Business Analyst – Capital Markets & Payments
Aug 2014 – Sep 2021

       Field-level Mapping (MT to ISO 20022)

Validate test case for positive and negative scenarios such as pain.001 initiation,pacs.008 execution, pacs.002 response, camt.056 return

Delivered regulatory and trading projects (Aramco IPO, Margin Trading, FIX).

Aware of SWIFT CBPR+, ECB Structured Remittance

HCL Technologies, Bangalore
Business Analyst – Banking & QA
May 2010 – May 2014

Drafted test strategies, user flows, and business logic validation.

Performed QA planning, defect management, and business case documentation.

Sapient, Bangalore
QA Engineer – Financial Services
May 2007 – May 2010

Executed testing and defect reporting for trading platforms.

Supported QA best practices and test automation initiatives.

Education

Bachelor of Engineering (Electronics & Communication Engineering)
Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT), Odisha
2001 – 2005
